_comment: Provider pricing per model, USD per 1M tokens. Starting-point rates — keep in sync with real Anthropic/OpenRouter/Replicate billing dashboards manually. Wrong numbers here never affect real billing (credits already handle that), only the accuracy of margin metrics. Adding a new model or provider is a config edit here plus one entry in src/modules/ai/providers/ — see ARCHITECTURE.md.
_not_yet_routed: These providers are registered and callable (src/modules/ai/providers/index.js) but not yet in aiRouter.js's ROUTES chains — add a rate here (real pricing, not this placeholder) before putting any of them in a route, so margin metrics stay meaningful. gpt-4o-mini/gemini-1.5-flash/llama-3.3-70b-versatile below are examples, not commitments to those specific models.

local-self-hosted.note: no per-token API cost, real cost is the hosting infra itself

_extension_point: custom_ai_models feature flag: when enabled, a user- or org-supplied model config (their own API key + endpoint) is validated against this same {input, output} shape and merged at runtime by src/modules/ai/providers/index.js — no schema change needed here.
